runs.error: [22345895e2] The project TokenFrugal is designed to save on Claude Code or Codex token usage by offloading routine coding tasks to a free local Large Language Model (LLM) like Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible API. It acts as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, allowing users to manage their paid cloud model usage for architecture and hard decisions while the local LLM handles routine coding tasks. The tool is particularly useful for side projects, college projects, or corporate seats with tight quotas. It requires Python 3.11+, git, Docker, and an MCP-capable agent like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor. The installation process involves cloning the repository, setting up a Python virtual environment, and installing dependencies. After installation, users need to start the backends, install the tool profiles, and set up their agent. The tool can be used by asking the agent to perform tasks like writing unit tests for a specific Python file. The choice of model per agent can be customized in the router/agents.yaml file.
